research.title: Classification Baselines for Tabular Data with Missing Predictors
bullets: Prepared tabular datasets by checking feature types, documenting missingness patterns, and fitting preprocessing transformations exclusively on training partitions.
Implemented logistic regression and random forest baselines under specified missingness conditions, recording discrimination and calibration metrics across held-out evaluation splits.

work.title: Data Validation and Batch Processing Services
bullets: Maintained Python batch processing components that validated incoming records, normalized field formats, and routed malformed inputs for operational review.
Added regression tests for parsing edge cases and investigated processing failures using service logs, documenting fixes and recovery procedures.

projects.title: Regularized Regression for Residential Energy Demand
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression baselines for residential energy prediction using standardized weather and calendar features in scikit-learn.
Selected regularization parameters through training-set cross-validation and examined held-out residuals by season to identify systematic prediction errors.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Baselines for Customer Segmentation
bullets: Implemented a Gaussian mixture clustering baseline using scikit-learn on standardized purchase summaries, comparing diagonal and full covariance assumptions.
Examined information criteria and cluster assignments across initializations, documenting sensitivity to feature scaling and the chosen number of components.
